comment: The filter is taken from Csound code by Victor Lazzarini, SKF.cpp:3. The R knob is turned into damping as two minus twice its value, SKF.cpp:10, so the knob reads as resonance. The menu item is lettered Level Input, SKF.cpp:660, which is the wording of the AUX module's level slider; the slider it opens is the cutoff slew, SKF.cpp:77-79, and its own label reads Slew. Both inputs are also configured as bypasses to their own outputs.
